title: Up The Tree
lines: Up The Tree is open until 19 January. Its top prize is Leetanns. Unc, Ace, Bhlue, Flop and Vi are featured. Half the pulls of their rarity give one of them.
In The Little Raid, Canopy is a new origin. Canopy figures start the fight up the tree, where nothing can reach them. Then they drop to their seats with a shield and mana.

more.head: Leaving every raid
points: Leaving now: Peep, Brew, Munch, Clutch and Orphion. You can still pull them at the Grove, and buy them in raids with your own figures.
Penguin Month has closed. You can only buy Yule in raids with your own figures, if you pulled Yule.

more.head: New figures
points: Vi (1 acorn, Canopy Chorus, and LHZ) gives 50 mana to the friend who last used an ability.
Flop (2 acorns, Canopy Bulwark) falls over for 2 seconds, and nothing can reach it. Then it gets up with 40% of its health back.
When Flop gets up, every enemy within 2 hexes has to attack it for 2 seconds.
Bhlue (3 acorns, Canopy Mender) shields every friend in its row: 180 for 4 seconds. In that time, the first enemy ability to hit each of them is blocked.
Ace (4 acorns, Canopy Slinger) attacks with the four aces in turn.
Spades hit the enemy with the least health, 40% harder. Hearts heal the most hurt friend.
Diamonds hit the enemy with the most armour, ignoring its armour. Clubs hit the enemy with the most mana, and take 15 of it.
Ace's ability, Full Deck, throws all four at once, 110 damage each.
Unc (5 acorns, Feather Slinger, and Canopy) pecks its target 8 times in 3 seconds, 82 damage each. If the target falls, the rest go to the enemy nearest it.
Leetanns (5 acorns, Canopy Fang, and Crafter) is Up The Tree's top prize. Each cast, it swings its next tool.
The axe does 380 damage and pushes the target 1 hex. The pickaxe does 380 damage and halves the target's armour for 5 seconds.
The rod pulls the farthest enemy to a hex beside Leetanns. The scythe does 290 damage to every enemy beside it, and heals it for half of that.
While Up The Tree is open, anyone can buy Leetanns in any raid.

more.head: Traits
points: Vi is LHZ too.
Canopy, with 3: Canopy figures start the fight up the tree for 2 seconds. Then they drop with a shield of 20% of their health and 30 mana.
Canopy, with 5: the shield is 35% of their health, and they drop with a full mana bar.
Crafter (Leetanns): after every 3 fights it fights on the board, you get a component.
Feather now has 4 steps, at 2, 3, 4 and 5. Feather figures attack 4%, 6%, 8% or 11% faster after every attack.
Slinger has a third step at 6. Each attack on the same target does 20% more than the last.

more.head: Emblems
points: A Good Branch is a new charm. The figure holding it counts as Canopy.
